actions.description: Removes one or more timed statuses from the resolved target set.

parameters.description: Status identifiers removed by this payload.
Who receives the cure payload.
How thoroughly the status is removed. full sets the counter to zero; halve divides the counter by two.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.1. cure_mode added in Action Catalog Stabilization Pass.

Duration expression for the granted timed status.

Duration expression for the oppose state.

actions.name: Map Area

Mapping radius when reveal_mode is area-scoped. Zero means level scope.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.1.

actions.name: Sleep Control
actions.description: Applies sleep control to one or more hostile targets.

parameters.description: Targeting envelope for the control payload.
Relative power used by downstream validation and resolution.
Area radius when target_mode is area-like.
Restricts the sleep effect to entities matching this tag. Omit to affect all entities.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.1. entity_filter added in Action Catalog Stabilization Pass.

actions.name: Modify Player Speed
actions.description: Applies a timed haste or slow effect to the player. Replaces ApplyTimedBuff(haste) usages with explicit speed semantics and canonical duration expressions.

parameters.description: Direction of the speed modification applied to the player.
Duration expression for the speed modification. Use level_multiplier for level-scaled durations.
Always self — player speed modifications apply only to the acting player.

provenance.summary: Redesigned in V2 Parity Pass. Replaces the former potency-based contract. Canonical action for all player haste and slow effects (set_fast, set_slow in MAngband). Duration is explicit and level-scalable via level_multiplier.

actions.name: Dispel By Tag

parameters.description: Tag filter used to choose affected entities.

actions.name: Beam Damage
actions.description: Directed linear damage payload with beam semantics.

Directional input or trajectory token for the beam path.

Optional terrain side-effect applied to each grid cell along the beam path. illuminate_path is the GF_LITE_WEAK grid effect that permanently lights cells. Stone to mud is the GF_KILL_WALL grid effect that converts stone to mud. Omit when no terrain effect applies.

provenance.summary: Approved as a canonical payload in Gameplay Architecture V2 section 9.2. light_weak damage type and terrain_effect parameter added in Action Catalog Stabilization Pass.

Target selection envelope for entity inspection.

provenance.summary: Added in Action Catalog Stabilization Pass. Canonical new action for PRAYER_PROBING semantics. Reusable across prayer, scroll, and device sources.

actions.name: Restore Attributes
actions.description: Restores drained stats and/or lost experience levels according to the selected scope.

parameters.description: Which attributes are restored by this payload.
Required when restore_scope is single_stat.
Who receives the restoration payload.

provenance.summary: Added in Action Catalog Stabilization Pass. Canonical new action for PRAYER_RESTORATION and PRAYER_REMEMBRANCE. Covers do_res_stat (single_stat and all_stats) and restore_level (experience_level) semantics.

actions.name: Remove Curse
actions.description: Removes one or all curses from the actor's equipped items.

parameters.description: Whether one curse or all curses are removed. single covers remove_curse; all covers remove_all_curse.

provenance.summary: Added in Action Catalog Stabilization Pass. Canonical new action for PRAYER_REMOVE_CURSE (scope=single) and PRAYER_DISPEL_CURSE (scope=all). Reusable by scroll sources.

actions.name: Modify Resource Meter
actions.description: Sets or adjusts a named actor resource meter such as the food satiation counter.

parameters.description: The named resource meter to modify.
How the meter value is changed.

provenance.summary: Added in Action Catalog Stabilization Pass. Canonical new action for Satisfy Hunger semantics. set_food(PY_FOOD_MAX-1) maps to mode=set_near_max. Reusable across spell and consumable sources.

actions.name: Modify Attribute
actions.description: Applies a canonical attribute modification operation using MAngband stat progression semantics.

parameters.description: Whether a single attribute or all attributes are modified.
Required when scope is single_stat.
The attribute operation to perform.
Whether the modification is permanent or restorable.
Who receives the attribute modification.

provenance.summary: Canonical action for MAngband attribute gain and attribute drain semantics. Uses native stat progression algorithms rather than explicit numeric adjustments. Attribute restoration remains represented by RestoreAttributes.

actions.name: Modify Experience
actions.description: Adjusts experience by a specified amount.

parameters.description: Signed experience adjustment.
Nature of the experience adjustment.
Who receives the experience adjustment.

provenance.summary: Canonical action for experience gain and experience drain semantics. Experience restoration remains represented by RestoreAttributes(experience_level).

actions.name: Transform Entity
actions.description: Replaces the resolved target entity with a randomly selected entity of the same class.

parameters.description: Rule governing the selection of the replacement entity.
Target selection mode for the transformation payload.

provenance.summary: Added in Action Catalog Stabilization Pass. Canonical new action for SPELL_POLYMORPH_OTHER. poly_monster replaces target with a random monster of the same approximate depth.

actions.name: Clone Monster
actions.description: Creates a duplicate copy of the targeted monster adjacent to its current position. The clone is a separate entity with full HP.

parameters.description: Directional input or trajectory token used to select the target monster.

provenance.summary: MAngband: clone_monster() calls multiply_monster() on the targeted monster. Distinct from TransformEntity (which replaces) and SummonEntities (which creates independent entities). Added to resolve rod_of_clone_monster and TransformEntity workaround.

actions.name: Modify Monster Speed
actions.description: Applies a temporary speed modification (haste or slow) to one or more monsters.

parameters.description: Direction of the speed modification applied to the target(s).
Targeting envelope. Use aimed for single-target directed use; all_in_los for sweep effects.

provenance.summary: MAngband: speed_monster() (single aimed) and speed_monsters() (all in LOS). Added to resolve rod_of_haste_monster and staff_of_haste_monsters unresolved mappings.

actions.name: Aggravate Monsters
actions.description: Awakens all sleeping monsters within the aggravation radius and causes all monsters within line of sight to move at maximum speed.

parameters.description: Wake radius for sleeping monsters. Zero means level-wide.

provenance.summary: MAngband: aggravate_monsters() wakes sleeping monsters within 40 squares and hastes monsters in LOS. Added to resolve scroll_of_aggravate_monster unresolved_mapping.

actions.name: Apply Item Curse
actions.description: Applies a destructive curse to the selected equipped item, removing special powers and applying a negative magical bonus.

parameters.description: Equipment slot containing the item to curse.
Numerator of the fractional chance (N in 2) that artifacts resist the curse. Default 1.

provenance.summary: MAngband: curse_armor() and curse_weapon() remove special powers and apply -2d5 magical penalty. Artifacts have 1-in-2 resistance. Added to resolve scroll_curse_armor and scroll_curse_weapon unresolved_mapping.

actions.name: Create Traps
actions.description: Creates random traps on all empty floor squares within a given radius of the caster.

parameters.description: Radius within which empty floor squares receive traps.
Center point for trap placement.

provenance.summary: MAngband: trap_creation() places traps on all empty floor squares in a 1-radius ring around the player. Added to resolve scroll_of_trap_creation unresolved_mapping.

actions.name: Apply Damage
actions.description: Applies direct HP damage to a resolved target set without projectile semantics. Covers self-inflicted damage (eating harmful consumables), thrown-item impact, environmental hazards, and melee damage that does not fit a more specific action.

parameters.description: Damage channel applied to the target.
Typed damage amount expression.
Who receives the damage. self covers eating/drinking harmful items; aimed covers thrown item impact.

provenance.summary: Added to resolve the consumable self-damage and thrown-damage gap identified in consumables.json. BoltDamage(direction=self) and BoltDamage(direction=thrown) were non-canonical workarounds. ApplyDamage has no projectile/beam semantics and covers the direct-application cases.
